ms.report:
INRGrid Stable Private Limited (INRC) has acquired a license from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, India. The company has partnered with the LegaLogic agency (PVS & Associates) to streamline its compliances. On top of that, INRGrid has also appointed an independent auditor from day zero to align its core competency of being transparent. INRGrid team attended the Stablecoin Summit 2024 in Singapore to understand the current regulatory stance among global stablecoin issuers. Attached is the complete report, published on Cardano Spot:
INRGrid Stablecoin Compliance Report 2024
